scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.json && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply viztos-db --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply viztos-db --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:pages: npm --prefix frontend run build && wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name viztos
